_comment: Merchant Signup Form - Stepwise Field Schema v1.0. All field keys match the API request parameter names. Slugs match the values accepted by EMAP's API, verified against EMAP's test server (https://emap.epd.dev).
_dynamicDropdownEndpointsNote: Every entry has a matching key in references/dropdown-fallbacks.json. If the live GET call errors, times out, or returns an empty/missing `data` array, serve that fallback snapshot instead of an empty result — see the fetchDropdownData()/EMAP_DROPDOWN_FALLBACKS pattern in templates/integration-1/plain-html.html.

states.note: US states only — shown only when country = US

_staticDropdownsNote: Options with a 'slug' key: send the slug value as the API param. Options with a 'value' key: send the integer or non-slug value as the API param.

steps.description: Collects the applicant's personal info and basic company details. Creates the user, company, and application record on submit.

fields.hint: If unavailable, link to your social media profile

fields.label: Formation Country
fields._integration2Note: Integration 2 only: EMAP's /signup page matches the country URL parameter against the option's display name, so the redirect URL carries `name` (e.g. United States), not `code`. Keep `code` on the option (e.g. data-code) for the US check. Integrations 1 and 3 send `code`.
fields.hint: Country where your company is legally registered

fields.label: Estimated Annual Sales
fields.note: EMAP's own label has no '(USD)' suffix — USD is shown only as separate hint text next to the field. Also, EMAP's variantA UI does not always collect this in Step 1: for the 'no_apollo' and 'textract' experiment variants it appears in Step 1 as shown here, but for the default 'mos_variant_a' variant Step 1 omits it entirely and it instead appears in Step 2 (Company Information) with this same label and hint. A partner form built against this skill only needs to send it once in Step 1 regardless of EMAP's own variant-dependent placement.

fields.label: Industry Type
fields._integration2Note: Integration 2 only: the redirect URL carries the industry `name`, not `slug`. Keep `slug` on the option (e.g. data-slug) for the 'other' check. Integrations 1 and 3 send `slug`.

fields.label: Industry Type Other
fields._note: Compare the industry slug to 'other' case-insensitively: EMAP returns this option's slug as 'Other'.

fields.label: Partner Key
fields.note: Optional partner attribution. Set as a constant in the client code and sent from the browser like every other field (there is no server side in this skill). It is an attribution value, not a secret, and is visible in the page source. Integration 2 passes the same value in EMAP's `secretKey` URL parameter.

steps.title: Company Information
steps.description: Legal structure, address, revenue model, and tax details for the business.

fields.note: UUID returned from Step 1 response

fields.label: Company Formation Date
fields.hint: Date the company was legally formed

fields.label: Federal Tax ID
fields.hint: Not required for Canada or Sole-Proprietorship

CA.label: Federal Tax ID
CA.validationNote: CA: 9 digits masked as XXX-XX-XXXX (blocks [3,2,4]). Label is plain 'Federal Tax ID', same as US — the '(or Corporation Tax Number equivalent)' wording applies to non-US/CA/PR countries only.

PR.label: Federal Tax ID
PR.validationNote: PR: same label/mask as US/CA — Puerto Rico groups with US/CA in EMAP's own isUSCanadaPR check. Omitting this variant silently falls through to 'default' and applies the WRONG mask (XX-XXXXXXX instead of XXX-XX-XXXX).

default.label: Federal Tax ID (or Corporation Tax Number equivalent)
default.validationNote: All other countries: 9 digits masked as XX-XXXXXXX (blocks [2,7]).

fields.note: Not required (hidden, disabled, un-required) when country_from_step1=='CA' OR business_organized=='Sole-Proprietorship'; required in every other case. This follows EMAP's signup page and the API's own error text ('required for all companies except Canada and Sole-Proprietorships'). Caveat: one earlier test submission of a US and a German Sole-Proprietorship without federal_tax_id was rejected with that same 422 — unresolved; if it recurs, EMAP's API needs to match its own message. Label and mask key off country_from_step1 independent of this: US/CA/PR grouped identically ('Federal Tax ID', XXX-XX-XXXX mask) versus every other country ('...or Corporation Tax Number equivalent', XX-XXXXXXX mask).

fields.label: Business Registration Number
fields.note: Required for every Step 1 country except US — simply 'country != US'. EMAP's signup form also treats Puerto Rico and a CA Sole-Proprietorship as exempt, but live testing shows the API requires it for both: a Puerto Rico submission without this field got a live 422 'Business register number is required for non-US companies'. A form built to match the signup UI's leniency for PR or CA-sole-prop will hit that same 422. US is the only exemption that actually works.

fields.label: Industry Type
fields.note: Only shown in this step if from_lander=1 (auto-submitted Step 1). For normal flow, industry_type is captured in Step 1.

fields.label: Revenue Model
fields.note: Send as array: marketingModel[] or marketingModel. Integer IDs (1, 2, 3).

fields.label: Other
fields.note: EMAP's own label for this field is just 'Other' (it sits directly beneath the Subscription Frequency dropdown, whose 'Other' option it explains) — not 'Subscription Frequency (Other)'.

fields.label: State
fields.note: EMAP's Legal Address section (company_address.blade.php) always renders this label as plain 'State', never 'State/Province', regardless of the company's formation country — verified as a template bug: the label is chosen with `isset($otherCountry) ? "State" : "State/Province"`, but the controller always passes `otherCountry` as a boolean key (`in_array($userCompanyRecord->country, ['1','2','3'])`), so `isset()` is true whether the value is true or false. By contrast, the Owner 1/2 home-address sections (step 4) use a direct truthy check (`$otherCountry ? "State" : "State/Province"`) and DO correctly show 'State' for US/CA/PR and 'State/Province' for every other formation country — see state.1/state.2 below.

usStateSelect.note: When address_country is US, render this field as a dropdown of dynamicDropdownEndpoints.states (send `code`, e.g. NY). For every other country, render a free-text box. Place the country field before this one, and re-check whenever the country changes.

fields.label: Zip
fields.note: Same isset() bug as the `state` field above: EMAP's Legal Address section always renders this label as 'Zip', never 'Postal code', regardless of formation country. The Owner 1/2 home-address sections correctly toggle between 'Postal code' and 'Zip' by country — see postal_code.1/postal_code.2 below.

fields.label: Is the mailing or physical address different from the legal address?
fields.note: EMAP's real question and Yes/No polarity are inverted from a literal reading of the field name: EMAP asks whether the address is DIFFERENT (not whether it's the same), and its 'Yes' (different) is sent to the API as is_physical_address_same_as_legal_address=0, while its 'No' (same) is sent as =1 (confirmed in variantA/step2/js.blade.php, where the radio option with DOM value 'yes' sets the submitted value to 0 and the default/unset state submits 1). The options below already carry the corrected values so 'value' matches what EMAP actually sends; the dependsOn/visibleIf blocks on the physical_address_* fields below (keyed to value '0') were already correct under this real polarity.

fields.label: Street Number
fields.note: EMAP's Physical/Mailing Address card drops the 'Physical' prefix on every field label in this section — it's implied by the card header instead.

fields.label: State
fields.note: Same isset($otherCountry) template bug as the Legal Address `state` field above — EMAP's Physical/Mailing Address card always renders 'State', never 'State/Province', regardless of formation country.

usStateSelect.note: When physical_address_country is US, render this field as a dropdown of dynamicDropdownEndpoints.states (send `code`, e.g. NY). For every other country, render a free-text box. Place the country field before this one, and re-check whenever the country changes.

fields.label: Zip
fields.note: Same isset($otherCountry) template bug as the Legal Address `postal_code` field above — always renders 'Zip', never 'Postal code', regardless of formation country.

steps.title: Owners
steps.description: Primary contact selection and owner identity information (SSN, DOB, driver's license, bankruptcy, home address). Supports up to 2 owners.

api.fieldNameConvention: Array notation with dot notation: first_name.1, last_name.1, ssn.1 for Owner 1; first_name.2, last_name.2 for Owner 2. Send as form fields or JSON.

fields.label: Are you the business owner?

options.label: Yes, I am the primary contact / owner
No, I am not the primary contact / owner

fields.note: If 1: do NOT send first_name.1, last_name.1, email.1 — backend uses Step 1 user data. If 0: all three are required.

fields.label: First Name
fields.note: Do NOT send when primary_contact=1 — backend uses Step 1 data

fields.label: Mobile Phone
fields.validationNote: Use intl-tel-input library. Validates E.164 international format. Call isValidNumber() before submit.

fields.label: SSN/SIN
fields.countryDependsOnNote: Verified against EMAP's own live behavior: the SSN mask and pattern for BOTH owners are driven by the SAME country — the Step 1 formation country, applied identically to Owner 1 AND Owner 2. The country that resolves this field's countryVariants is that SINGLE Step 1 formation country — NOT each owner's own country.1/country.2 (home address/residence, a separate field used only for driver_license_state gating, see the driver_license_state.1 field below). Do not key this off country.1.

US.label: SSN/SIN
US.validationNote: 9-digit SSN in XXX-XX-XXXX format. Cleave.js applies mask automatically. Validate: ssn.replace(/-/g, '').length >= 9 (displays as 11 chars with dashes). Error: 'Please enter at least 9 digits'.

CA.label: SSN/SIN
CA.validationNote: 9-digit Canadian SIN in XXX-XX-XXXX format. Same mask as US SSN.

PR.label: SSN/SIN
PR.validationNote: Puerto Rico uses the US SSN in XXX-XX-XXXX format. Same mask as US SSN.

default.label: SSN (or personal Tax ID equivalent)
default.validationNote: For countries other than US/CA/PR: accept plain-text tax identification or government ID number. No input mask or pattern applied — only enforce length < 11 (maxLength 10).

fields.note: Verified directly in EMAP's own signup form (variantA/step4/form.blade.php, span#first_owner_ssn_label / span#second_owner_ssn_label): the label is NOT split by country the way one might expect from the mask/pattern differences below — EMAP renders the identical generic text "SSN/SIN" for US, CA, and PR alike (it never shows a distinct Social Insurance Number label for Canada, nor any Owner 1/Owner 2 prefix), and "SSN (or personal Tax ID equivalent)" for every other country. Unlike federal_tax_id (which IS corrected client-side by manageFederalTaxIdLabel() after page load — see the Step 2 federal_tax_id note), no corrective JS exists here; this is a genuine, permanent EMAP UI quirk, not a transient bug. The label above intentionally matches EMAP's real flattened wording so a partner form built from this skill looks identical to EMAP's own — the underlying mask/pattern/validation still correctly differ per country even though the visible text does not. Never store or log this value. Send over HTTPS only. For US, CA, and PR: 9 digits masked as XXX-XX-XXXX via Cleave.js (blocks [3,2,4]). The backend receives the masked value with dashes. For all other countries: plain text, no mask/pattern, length must be < 11 characters (maxLength 10). The country driving this is country_from_step1 (see countryDependsOn) — the same value for both owners.

fields.label: Date of Birth (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.validationNote: Owner must be at least 18 years old. Max date = today minus 18 years. Min year = current year minus 100. Must be a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Enforce this client-side (date input min/max + submit-time check) — do not rely on the HTML date input's min/max alone. EMAP's own API does not enforce this rule server-side (verified directly against its validation rules), so the client-side check is the only enforcement that exists; that is a pre-existing gap in EMAP itself, not something a partner form can close.

fields.label: % of Company Owned
fields.validationNote: Must be a whole number — no decimals allowed. Enforced client-side via custom validPercentage jQuery validator. Decimals are rejected.
fields.note: If < 51%, Owner 2 fields become required

fields.label: State
fields.note: Correctly toggles in EMAP (unlike the Step 2 Legal/Physical Address bug documented above): shows 'State' when country_from_step1 (the company's Step 1 formation country, NOT this owner's own country.1) is US/CA/PR, and 'State/Province' otherwise — verified via a direct truthy check `$otherCountry ? "State" : "State/Province"` in owner1_home_address.blade.php.

usStateSelect.note: When country.1 is US, render this field as a dropdown of dynamicDropdownEndpoints.states (send `code`, e.g. NY). For every other country, render a free-text box. Place the country field before this one, and re-check whenever the country changes.

fields.label: Zip
fields.note: Correctly toggles: 'Zip' when country_from_step1 is US/CA/PR, 'Postal code' otherwise — same country_from_step1 driver as state.1 above, correctly implemented (contrast with the Step 2 bug).

fields.label: Driver’s License Expiration
fields.validationNote: Any valid date, including a past one. EMAP's signup accepts an expired licence, so don't reject it here.

fields.label: Has {owner_name} ever filed bankruptcy?
fields.note: Dynamic/personalized in EMAP, not a static 'Owner 1:' prefix — the real template is "Has {name} ever filed bankruptcy?" where {name} resolves to Auth::user()->full_name (the account holder's real name).

fields.label: Bankruptcy Discharge Date
fields.validationNote: Must be today or in the past. Future dates are rejected.

fields.labelNote: EMAP's real 'Owner Information' step (variantA/step4/form.blade.php and its owner1_*/owner2_* partials) never labels these fields with an 'Owner 1'/'Owner 2' prefix — ownership is conveyed only via the enclosing card's header (e.g. "{name}'s Details", "{name}'s Home Address", "{name}'s Driver's License Details"). Every field below whose label in this schema starts with 'Owner 1'/'Owner 2' renders in EMAP without that prefix (e.g. 'Owner 1 First Name' shows as just 'First Name'); fields with a different discrepancy (ssn, license, driver_license_state, driver_license_expiration_date, bankruptcy_*, ownership_percentage, phone) are annotated individually below since their wording differs by more than just the prefix.

fields.note: ALL Owner 2 fields are required when ownership_percentage.1 < 51

fields.note: Verified directly in EMAP's own signup form (variantA/step4/form.blade.php, span#second_owner_ssn_label): same generic "SSN/SIN" text as ssn.1 for US/CA/PR alike (no distinct SIN wording for Canada, no Owner 1/Owner 2 prefix), and "SSN (or personal Tax ID equivalent)" for every other country — see ssn.1's note for the full explanation. The label above intentionally matches EMAP's real flattened wording. Never store or log. Send over HTTPS only. For US, CA, and PR: 9 digits masked as XXX-XX-XXXX via Cleave.js. For all other countries: plain text, no mask/pattern, length must be < 11 characters (maxLength 10).
